offer.canonicalRussian: HSK AI-ро санҷ. Ба профил даро, пайвандро кушо, HSK AI-ро боргирӣ кун ва ҳар рӯз забони чиниро омӯз.
offer.immediateAction: Open the profile link, download HSK AI, and learn Chinese every day.
offer.fulfillment: The viewer follows the profile link to download HSK AI and can use it as part of a daily Chinese-learning routine.

policy.primaryCountDefinition: Unique viewers who open the HSK AI profile link divided by platform views × 1000; preserve the platform metric definition and observation window. Record website downloads separately when provided.
policy.thresholdNote: Initial operating defaults, not statistical significance. Compare the same platform, time window, metric definition, offer, HSK level, duration band, hook format, voice profile, and registered comparison group. Vary one CTA element. Topic/audience differences remain possible confounders. Missing counts are unknown, never zero.
policy.primaryAction: Visit the profile, open its link, download HSK AI, and learn Chinese every day.
localizedGuardrails: One central stage and one visible HSK AI wordmark at a time. No duplicate logo or moving focus marker.
Use profile, profile-links screenshot, branded download card and daily-learning closing card at their exact spoken Tajik cues. No website screenshot or simulated download completion.
Preserve the authorized profile-link/download direction; no comment/DM CTA, automatic DM, invented feature, speed, guarantee or free-offer claim.
Russian performance is not Tajik evidence. Keep measurements language-scoped and do not auto-promote.

experiments.hypothesis: Localized baseline of the authorized profile-link/download direction, with native Tajik narration and exact translated word cues. No performance improvement is claimed.
